name: Benefits — NPAR pathology: the last of the deductible meets the OOP maximum, pay the rest of the allowed amount
description: Twenty guided steps built from the Benefits.8 story: price the line, work through the 5Ws of Benefit (the provider's specialty and participation, the procedure, the date of service, the claim type and place of service, the diagnosis) with Code Set lookups, find the Testing Services → Professional service-level benefit for the NPAR provider, check the out-of-pocket limits and the accumulators, calculate what the member owes, validate to apply the benefits and confirm them on Claim Lines, then pay the claim.

steps.name: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure
steps.description: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure. Open the Search tab, then the Pricing sub-tab, scroll down to the Claim lines section and click Get Pricing. The allowed amount then shows in the Allowed column. Review it together with the Billed amount (the bill charge) and the Write-off: the allowed amount is the bill charge less the write-off. For procedure 81408 the bill charge is $890.00, the allowed amount is $670.00 and the write-off is $220.00.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Get Pricing is clicked in Search → Pricing.
steps.hint: Search tab → Pricing sub-tab → Claim lines → Get Pricing. Allowed = Billed − Write-off.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure

steps.name: Who — check the provider specialty
steps.description: Start the 5Ws of Benefit, which decide the right benefit for the claim. The first W is Who. Open the Provider Info tab and, in the Rendering section, read the Speciality and Speciality description fields: the provider's specialty is PATHOLOGY (022).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Provider Info tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Provider Info → Rendering → Speciality and Speciality description: PATHOLOGY.

steps.name: Who — confirm provider participation
steps.description: Continue the Who review on the Claim Header tab. In the General Claim Data section, the Provider Participation field reads NPAR: the provider does not participate in the network, so the NPAR benefits, limits and accruals apply throughout this claim.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Header tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Header → General Claim Data → Provider Participation: NPAR.

steps.name: What — identify the procedure code
steps.description: The next W is What. Open the Claim Lines tab and find the procedure code on line 1: 81408. You look it up in Code Set next.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → Procedure: 81408.

steps.name: What — review the procedure code details
steps.description: Look up the procedure code. Open the Search tab, then the Code Set sub-tab. Procedure Code (Px) is already selected in Select Code Type and 81408 is in Enter Code, with the search already performed. Note the description — MOLECULAR PATHOLOGY PROCEDURE, LEVEL 9 (EG, ANALYSIS OF >50 EXONS IN A SINGLE GENE BY DNA SEQUENCE ANALYSIS) FBN1 — and the service classes CA5, SU3 (SUTTER GENETIC TEST), VA1 (VA HMO LAB CORP), 20A (LAB), 20I (SOS LAB PROC), 39 (NY BUNDLE CODE), 99S (SUTTER AUTH WAIVED) and 99Z (HMO OFFICE SERVICE). Together they tell you the service billed: a molecular pathology laboratory test.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Code Set sub-tab is opened while this step is active. Sub-tabs start closed, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: Search tab → Code Set sub-tab. The 81408 lookup is already shown.
steps.checklistItem: What — review the procedure code details

steps.name: When — note the date of service
steps.description: The next W is When. Go back to the Claim Lines tab and read the date of service on line 1 from its From date and To columns: 02/23/2026.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → From date and To: 02/23/2026.
steps.checklistItem: When — note the date of service

steps.name: Where — check the claim type
steps.description: The next W is Where: where the service was performed. Start with the claim type. Open the Claim Data tab, then the Details sub-tab, and in the Additional Claim Data section read the Claim type field: PA - Professional.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Data → Details sub-tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Data → Details → Additional Claim Data → Claim type: PA - Professional.

steps.name: Where — note the place of service
steps.description: Check the place of service on the claim. On the Claim Lines tab, the POS field on line 1 reads 11.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → POS: 11.
steps.checklistItem: Where — note the place of service

steps.name: Where — confirm the POS description
steps.description: Look up the POS code. Open Search → Code Set and choose Place of Service (POS) in Select Code Type. Line 1's code, 11, fills in and its result shows straight away: the description is Office.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the POS 11 lookup is shown in Code Set — by choosing Place of Service (POS), or by searching that type for 11.
steps.hint: Search → Code Set → Select Code Type: Place of Service (POS). POS 11 is Office.

steps.name: Why — identify the diagnosis code
steps.description: The final W is Why. On the Claim Lines tab, find the diagnosis code on line 1: M357.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → Diagnosis: M357.

steps.name: Why — review the diagnosis code details
steps.description: Look up the diagnosis code. Open Search → Code Set and choose Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10) in Select Code Type. Line 1's diagnosis, M357, fills in and the search is applied: the description is HYPERMOBILITY SYNDROME, and the Limit class is 030 (ALLOWABLE BACK SERVICES).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the M357 lookup is shown in Code Set — by choosing Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10), or by searching that type for M357.
steps.hint: Search → Code Set → Select Code Type: Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10).
steps.checklistItem: Why — review the diagnosis code details

steps.name: Open the benefits for the contract
steps.description: With the 5Ws complete — a Pathology provider that is NPAR, procedure 81408 on 02/23/2026, a PA - Professional claim at POS 11 (Office), diagnosis M357 — check the benefits that apply. Open the Search tab, then the Benefits sub-tab, and make sure the date of service, 02/23/2026, falls inside the contract's Effective date and End date (01/01/2026 – 12/31/9999).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Benefits sub-tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Search tab → Benefits sub-tab. 02/23/2026 falls inside 01/01/2026 – 12/31/9999.
steps.checklistItem: Open the benefits for the contract

steps.name: Locate the benefit category and subcategory
steps.description: Click + next to Service level to open the benefit categories, listed under a Benefits Category search box. Open the Benefit Hierarchy Service Categories Document to identify the Major Category and subcategory to select as per the Procedure details previously identified. From the details you noted, the major category is Testing Services and the subcategory is Professional. The procedure decides the category: 81408 is a molecular pathology test, and its service classes include 20A - LAB, so the benefit sits under Testing Services. The claim type decides the subcategory: this is a PA - Professional claim, so it is Professional, not Facility. Expand Testing Services with its arrow to show its subcategories, Facility and Professional, then expand Professional to show the additional categories beneath it: Diagnostic Imaging, Infertility, Lab, Maternity, Other Studies, Pathology, Pre-Admit Testing and Routine. Check whether any of them carries a benefit of its own for this procedure. Lab and Pathology name the kind of test, but on this contract neither carries a benefit of its own — View Benefits on either shows none — so Professional under Testing Services is the benefit to use.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Professional is expanded under Testing Services. Expanding Testing Services itself, or any other category, completes nothing.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → + Service level → expand Testing Services → expand Professional. Service class 20A - LAB picks Testing Services; the PA - Professional claim picks Professional.
steps.checklistItem: Locate the benefit category and subcategory

steps.name: Review the Testing Services benefits for the NPAR provider
steps.description: Click View Benefits on the same Professional row under Testing Services. A dialog titled Service level opens and lists the place-of-service options. The POS is 11, Office, and the office entry has two options, both OFFICE — TIER - 1. Open each option's triangle and use the Network column to tell them apart: the provider on this claim does not participate in the network, so the option showing NPAR is the benefit for this procedure. It shows an individual deductible of $5,000.00 (NINDED), a family deductible of $10,000.00 (NFMDED), coinsurance of 70.00%, and Y for the deductibles and coinsurance included in OOP, the adjudication indicator and the benefit covered indicator. The other option shows PAR, with a $4,000.00 individual deductible, an $8,000.00 family deductible and 80.00% coinsurance. So the member pays the $5,000.00 individual or the $10,000.00 family deductible, whichever is met first; after that the plan covers 70% of the allowed amount and the member pays 30% as coinsurance. Close the dialog.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the OFFICE option whose Network column reads NPAR is opened. The PAR option and the other options complete nothing.
steps.hint: View Benefits on Testing Services → Professional → open both OFFICE options → the one showing NPAR is the benefit.
steps.checklistItem: Review the Testing Services benefits for the NPAR provider

steps.name: Review the Out-of-Pocket limits
steps.description: Click + next to Plan Level on the same Benefits sub-tab, then scroll to the Out-of-pocket table to check the out-of-pocket limits for this service. The provider is NPAR, so read only the NPAR rows: the individual OOP limit is $6,000.00 and the family OOP limit is $12,000.00 (the PAR limits are $3,500.00 and $7,000.00). You already reviewed the deductible limits under the service-level benefit, so they need no second look.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Plan Level is opened.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → + Plan Level → Out-of-pocket: NPAR $6,000.00 individual, $12,000.00 family.

steps.name: Review the accrued deductible
steps.description: Now check how much of the deductible and OOP limits the member has already accrued. In the Accumulators section of the same sub-tab, open the DEDUCTIBLE group. For the benefit year 01/01/2026 – 12/31/2026 it shows INDIVIDUAL DED PAR 3000.00, INDIVIDUAL DED NONPAR 4950.00, FAMILY DEDUCTIBLE PAR 6000.00 and FAMILY DEDUCTIBLE NONPAR 8300.00. The provider is NPAR, so only the NONPAR rows apply: NINDED and NFMDED.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the DEDUCTIBLE accumulator group is expanded.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → Accumulators → DEDUCTIBLE. NONPAR: individual 4950.00, family 8300.00.

steps.name: Review the accrued Out-of-Pocket
steps.description: Open the OUT OF POCKET group in the Accumulators section. For the same period it shows INDIVIDUAL OOP PAR 3500.00, INDIVIDUAL OOP NONPAR 5950.00, FAMILY OOP PAR 7000.00 and FAMILY OOP NONPAR 9300.00. Again, only the NONPAR rows apply: OINOOP and FOOPNPOC.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the OUT OF POCKET accumulator group is expanded.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → Accumulators → OUT OF POCKET. NONPAR: individual 5950.00, family 9300.00.

steps.name: Calculate the benefits to apply
steps.description: Summarise what you found and work out the benefits for line 1, then open the Claim Lines tab, where they will be applied. Claim: bill charge $890.00, allowed $670.00, write-off $220.00. Benefits (NPAR): individual deductible $5,000.00, family deductible $10,000.00, coinsurance 70%. OOP limits (NPAR): individual $6,000.00, family $12,000.00. Accrued (NONPAR): individual deductible 4950.00, family deductible 8300.00, individual OOP 5950.00, family OOP 9300.00. Remaining deductible: individual $5,000.00 − 4950.00 = $50.00; family $10,000.00 − 8300.00 = $1,700.00. Remaining OOP: individual $6,000.00 − 5950.00 = $50.00; family $12,000.00 − 9300.00 = $2,700.00. The member still owes $50.00 toward the individual deductible, the smaller of the two remainders, so $50.00 of the allowed amount is applied as deductible and the individual deductible is then met. The benefit counts the deductible toward the OOP (IND DEDUCTIBLE INCLUDED IN OOP reads Y), so that $50.00 also uses up the $50.00 remaining before the individual out-of-pocket maximum. The member's 30% coinsurance on the remaining $620.00 would be $186.00, but coinsurance counts toward the OOP too (COINSURANCE INCLUDED IN OOP reads Y) and the member cannot owe more than the OOP maximum, so no coinsurance can be applied. The balance of the allowed amount, $670.00 − $50.00 = $620.00, is paid. Only the write-off and the deductible are updated on line 1, each with its EOB code: PX_00066 for the $220.00 write-off and PX_00038 for the $50.00 deductible.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: $50.00 finishes the individual deductible and reaches the individual OOP maximum, so no coinsurance applies: EOB PX_00066 for the $220.00 write-off, PX_00038 for the $50.00 deductible, and $620.00 paid.

steps.name: Validate and confirm the applied benefits
steps.description: With the amounts worked out, click the Validate button on the claim summary. The system then applies the benefits to the claim automatically, and the values change on the Claim Lines tab you are already on. Check that the amounts and EOB codes Validate applied match your calculation: Line 1 — Benefits now shows EOB PX_00066 with a write-off of $220.00, EOB PX_00038 with a deductible of $50.00, no coinsurance or copay EOB, $620.00 paid, and the Benefit rule LABPROF - LAB. These values appear only after Validate.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Validate is clicked on the claim summary bar.
steps.hint: Validate sits on the claim summary bar, next to Submit. Then read Line 1 — Benefits on the Claim Lines tab.
steps.checklistItem: Validate and confirm the applied amounts and EOB codes
steps.completionToast: Benefits applied to line 1 — write-off and deductible posted, the rest of the allowed amount paid.

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: Once the benefits are applied and confirmed, pay the claim. Choose Pay from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit on the claim summary bar.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Pay decision is submitted.
steps.hint: Choose 'Pay' from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit.
